applicationProcess.process_md: &amp;amp;gt; **Registration of a Construction Worker under BBOCWWB:** **Step 1:** Visit the [Official Website](https://bocwscheme.bihar.gov.in/home) of the Bihar Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. **Step 2:** On the homepage, click on &amp;amp;amp;quot;[Labour Registration](https://bocwscheme.bihar.gov.in/worker_reg)&amp;amp;amp;quot;. **Step 3:** Enter your Aadhar card number and name, then click &amp;amp;amp;quot;Authenticate&amp;amp;amp;quot;. **Step 4:** A dashboard will appear. Enter all required details, ensuring that all fields marked with an asterisk (*) are filled in correctly. **Step 5:** Click on &amp;amp;amp;quot;Submit&amp;amp;amp;quot; and proceed to pay the application fee online. **Step 6:** You will receive your construction worker registration number upon successful registration. &amp;amp;gt; **Apply for Scheme Benefits:** **Step 1:** Visit the [Official Website](https://bocwscheme.bihar.gov.in/home) of the Bihar Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. **Step 2:** Click on &amp;amp;amp;quot;Login&amp;amp;amp;quot; and select &amp;amp;amp;quot;Labour&amp;amp;amp;quot;. **Step 3:** Enter your registration number &amp;amp;amp;amp; year of Birth, click &amp;amp;amp;quot;Show&amp;amp;amp;quot; to view your details. **Step 4:** Select the scheme you wish to apply for to avail the benefits. **Step 5:** Enter all required information and upload the necessary documents. **Step 6:** Click on &amp;amp;amp;quot;Submit Application&amp;amp;amp;quot; to complete the process. &amp;amp;gt; **Application Tracking:** Applicant can track their application status online through the [official website](https://bocwscheme.bihar.gov.in/home) of the Bihar Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. Relevant updates will be sent to the registered mobile number.

children.text: The applicant should be a dependent of a deceased worker.
The worker, in his/her lifetime, should have been registered with the "Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board".
The worker, in his/her lifetime, should have been in receipt of regular pension from the Board.

schemeContent.briefDescription: The scheme "Family Pension" by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (BBOCWWB), Labour Resources Department, Government of Bihar, provides pension to the dependent of the deceased pensioner of the Board.
